_comment: Single source of truth for What's New on every platform. The web page (whats-new.html) and the iOS app (WhatsNewView) both render this file. Keep bodies plain text; put a hyperlink in `link` (web renders it, apps ignore it). Entries whose features need a new app build wait in `coming_soon` until the build ships, then move into `entries` with a date. Dates are M/D.

coming_soon.title: Rate your backlog on iPhone and iPad.
coming_soon.body: Rate a show right from its detail screen, or knock out your whole unrated backlog from a new “Rate my backlog” screen — next to Subscription audit on Home, the iPad sidebar, and your own page. Works offline too: rate a show with no connection and it queues up and syncs the moment you're back online. Apple TV and Apple Watch show ratings but stay view-only, same as everywhere else on those apps.

coming_soon.title: Show Picker Club comes to Roku.
coming_soon.body: A native Roku app, built with Roku's own controls but working just like the Apple TV app: Trending and members on Home, everyone's four lists (Watching, Awaiting, Loved, Next Up), full show details, cross-library search, and add/move/archive right from the couch. Sign in with an email or phone one-time code. Some streaming deep links and trailers work differently on Roku than on Apple TV. Now on Roku.

entries.title: Private groups.
entries.body: Share show lists with just your friends, not the whole club. Create a private group, invite friends via link, then browse what they're watching this month (Trending), see their show counts, and manage members — all in the group. iPhone, iPad, and web let you create groups, invite, and manage. Apple TV lets you browse your groups and see what's trending, read-only. Thanks Fiona!

entries.title: Rate what you've watched.
entries.body: Give any show or movie a rating right from its detail page — tap a number, done, no Save button. See the whole club's average (Club Rating) alongside each title, and the specific member's score when you're looking at their copy. Rate the overall show or, for a TV series, each season on its own. Not ready to rate one at a time? Rate my backlog is a one-page list of everything you haven't scored yet — rate it and it drops off the list. Now on the web.

entries.title: Audit subscriptions for your whole household.
entries.body: On the Subscription audit, tap Household at the top and check the members you share streaming services with. Your audit then pools everyone's shows — so a service someone in your household is watching counts as one to keep, instead of looking cancellable just because it's not on your own list. Your household is remembered. Now on the web, iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Thanks Matt K for the idea!

entries.title: Richer show details.
entries.body: Every show's detail screen now carries a lot more: a plot synopsis, a wide backdrop image, an audience score, the maturity rating (TV-MA, R, …), release year, runtime, the director or creator, and a trailer link. And when a show has no direct deep link, you'll now get a “Where to watch” link instead of just the network name. It's all pulled in automatically. Now on the web, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV, and Apple Watch.

entries.title: Export your lists.
entries.body: Take your shows with you anytime — no lock-in. Open the account menu and choose Export my lists to get a plain-text file with every list (Watching, Awaiting, Loved, Next Up) and each show's network. On the web it downloads a .txt file; on iPhone and iPad it opens the share sheet so you can drop it into Notes, Messages, Files, or anywhere else. Now on the web, iPhone, and iPad.

entries.title: Home-screen widgets on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
entries.body: App version 1.0.3 brings two widgets: Trending (what the club is picking up right now) and Upcoming Premieres (your next premieres from Watching and Awaiting, by date), in small, medium, and large sizes — plus an iPhone Lock Screen version of Upcoming. Tap any show to jump straight to its card in the app.

entries.title: Put your lists in your order.
entries.body: Every list's sort menu now has My Order (drag to sort) on your own page. Pick it and each row grows a ☰ handle — drag shows up or down and the order saves instantly, per list. On another member's page the same menu offers “their Order” so you can browse a list the way its owner arranged it (viewing only — you can't change their order). Apple TV and Apple Watch show saved orders automatically. Thanks Joe P!

entries.title: Premiere dates on every list.
entries.body: The “📅 Next episode” line now shows on Loved and Next Up too, not just Watching and Awaiting — sometimes a show you thought was done drops a surprise season, and that date is your nudge to move it back to Watching.

entries.title: Show Picker is on the Apple App Store.
entries.body: Native apps for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Watch — same lists, same login, everywhere.

link.label: Get Show Picker Club on the App Store

entries.title: New list names.
entries.body: Recommending is now Loved (shows you've watched and loved) and Up Next is now Next Up. Same lists, better names — everything on them came along. The premiere-date line on show rows now reads “Next episode:” so it doesn't collide with the Next Up list.

entries.title: Subscription Audit.
entries.body: Paying for streaming you don't watch? The Subscription Audit shows which services to keep, pause, or cancel based on what's actually on your lists. Thanks Roger!

entries.title: Pick the right show as you type.
entries.body: Start typing a title in Add and matching shows appear with their posters — tap one to lock in the exact match. Its artwork, rating, cast, and season dates come along automatically, and it knows whether it's a show or a movie, so nothing needs fixing later.

entries.title: See the full poster.
entries.body: Tapping a show's artwork on its detail page opened it full screen. (Retired 8/2026 — the tap turned out to confuse more people than it helped, on every platform. Detail screens still lead with the full-width image.)

entries.title: Shake to pick.
entries.body: On iPhone, give your phone a shake to pull a random show from your Next Up list — an instant answer to “what should we watch?”

entries.title: Share a show.
entries.body: Send any show to a friend through the standard share sheet — text, email, or any app — from a show's detail screen in the iOS app.

entries.title: Seasons released.
entries.body: Show rows now tell you how many seasons have dropped, right next to the premiere date (e.g. “Next episode: 6/1 · 3 seasons”). Thanks Paula!

entries.title: Calendar feed.
entries.body: Each member page has a 📅 Calendar feed link. Subscribe in Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, or Fantastical to get upcoming season premieres and finales from that member's Watching and Awaiting lists, updated daily.

entries.title: Vibe.
entries.body: See a personality fingerprint based on each member's taste: cluster name, top trait signals, balance read, and shows aligned with the vibe. Pick any member from the dropdown. Thanks Matt!

entries.title: Quick actions.
entries.body: On the Watching list, “Watched it” moves a show to Loved and “Season done” moves it to Awaiting. No dropdown needed.

entries.title: Genre tags.
entries.body: Shows display genre info (Drama, Comedy, Thriller, etc.) pulled from TMDB.

entries.title: Share this list.
entries.body: Share a member's list with friends via text, email, or clipboard.

entries.title: What Members Are Watching.
entries.body: The home page shows the most popular shows across all members. Tap + to add any of them to your own list.

entries.title: Sort your lists.
entries.body: Use the sort dropdown at the bottom of any list to sort by Rating (default), A–Z, or Date Added.

entries.title: Watching With field.
entries.body: Track who you're watching a show with.

entries.title: Series Complete icon.
entries.body: Shows that have ended get a 🎬 badge.

entries.title: Season dates.
entries.body: See when the next season starts (and when it ends) pulled automatically from TMDB.

entries.title: Multi-member support.
entries.body: One app, multiple members, each with their own lists and login codes. Thanks Sherry!

entries.title: Initial launch.
entries.body: Add, edit, move, and archive shows across four lists. Auto-enriched with IMDb ratings, actors, and network links.
